premise: In the morning fog Acorn counts her friends for a game and always gets one too few; they search for the missing one until Ladybug counts again and finds who Acorn forgot: Acorn.
inspiration: The folk tale of the travellers who each forget to count themselves (the Wise Men of Gotham), turned into a counting game where the one who was missing was right there, counting.

en-US.title: Acorn Counts Her Friends
en-US.text: {canvas:fog 0.6 22s} [excited] It was a misty morning, and {acorn:enter} Acorn wanted to play hide-and-seek. {acorn:hop x2} But first, let's count! {ladybug:enter} {ladybug:pulse} Ladybug, one. {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:pulse} Hedgehog, two. {mouse:enter} {mouse:pulse} Mouse, three. {acorn:face surprised} [gasps] Three? We're four! Someone's missing! {mouse:live sniff} {sfx:sniff} Mouse sniffed the air. Nobody. {hedgehog:live curl hold} Hedgehog curled up to think. {acorn:live talk} Oh, a pebble! said Acorn. {hedgehog:live curl resume} It's ME, said Hedgehog, peeking out. [giggles] So Acorn counted again. Ladybug, one. Hedgehog, two. Mouse, three. {acorn:face sad} Still three! {acorn:live wish hold} She closed her eyes tight and wished. Please, let us find our friend. {ladybug:go to acorn} Ladybug crawled over. [playfully] Let ME count. {ladybug:live talk} Hedgehog, one. Mouse, two. Me, three. And… {ladybug:sparkle} YOU, four! {canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s} {sfx:birds} The fog lifted. {acorn:live wish resume} Acorn opened her eyes. {acorn:face happy} [laughs] She had forgotten to count herself! {all:face happy} {all:wobble x2} Everyone laughed. And ever since, when Acorn counts, she starts like this: Acorn… ONE!

es-ES.title: Bellota cuenta a sus amigos
es-ES.text: {canvas:fog 0.6 22s} [excited] Era una mañana de niebla, y {acorn:enter} Bellota quería jugar al escondite. {acorn:hop x2} ¡Pero primero, a contar! {ladybug:enter} {ladybug:pulse} Mariquita, uno. {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:pulse} Erizo, dos. {mouse:enter} {mouse:pulse} Ratón, tres. {acorn:face surprised} [gasps] ¿Tres? ¡Si somos cuatro! ¡Falta alguien! {mouse:live sniff} {sfx:sniff} Ratón olfateó el aire. Nadie. {hedgehog:live curl hold} Erizo se hizo una bola para pensar. {acorn:live talk} ¡Anda, una piedra! dijo Bellota. {hedgehog:live curl resume} ¡Que soy YO! dijo Erizo, asomando el hocico. [giggles] Bellota volvió a contar. Mariquita, uno. Erizo, dos. Ratón, tres. {acorn:face sad} ¡Otra vez tres! {acorn:live wish hold} Cerró los ojos muy fuerte y pidió un deseo: que encontremos a nuestra amiga. {ladybug:go to acorn} Mariquita se acercó. [playfully] Déjame contar a MÍ. {ladybug:live talk} Erizo, uno. Ratón, dos. Yo, tres. Y… {ladybug:sparkle} ¡TÚ, cuatro! {canvas:sunshine 0.8 14s} {sfx:birds} La niebla se levantó. {acorn:live wish resume} Bellota abrió los ojos. {acorn:face happy} [laughs] ¡Se le había olvidado contarse a sí misma! {all:face happy} {all:wobble x2} Todos se echaron a reír. Y desde entonces, cuando Bellota cuenta, empieza así: Bellota… ¡UNO!
